 Job Description:
 
 The Role 

 As a software engineer in Core Internet Platforms, you will design, build, and operate scalable backend systems and cloud-native services. This role plays a critical part in building and maintaining secure authentication and authorization systems, with direct responsibility for protecting user identities, access, and sensitive data across Fidelity. This role requires strong engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience with Go and understanding of cloud deployments . 

 Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable, reliable backend services using Go (experience with additional languages such as Java, C, Python is a plus)
 Own services throughout their lifecycle: design, development, testing, deployment, and operations 
 Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions
 Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes, tooling, and CI/CD pipelines
 Employ problem solving skills to analyze sophisticated engineering challenges
 
 The Expertise and Skills You Bring 
 Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, OOP, basic system design)
 1 plus years of programming experience in Java, Node.js, Go, or comparable building high throughput APIs.
 Understanding of software development practices (Git, code reviews, testing, debugging)
 Knowledge of web services, APIs, and cloud concepts
 Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
 Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies quickly
 Strong problem solving, written and verbal communication skills
 Interest in leveraging AI tools to enhance development productivity and learning
  
 The Team 
 Our platform team is focused on building foundational capabilities in the application security area that serves Fidelity customers. You will be part of a team of engineers that are revolutionizing how Fidelity delivers industry leading customer experiences. Contribute to an engineering community focused on collaboration, consistency, and developer experience.
 Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
